lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Dust motes dance in the golden light
Ancient spines line the hallowed hall
One inkwell stains the parchment white
She hears the shadows begin to call
[Pre-Chorus]
Time is folding like a heavy wing
Every memory is a secret song
[Chorus]
The empire falls into the deep
History sighs in a restless sleep
Stone and spirit, fire and grace
Time leaves a mark no heart can erase

The ghosts of kings begin to laugh
Where the earth and heavens intertwine

Nowhere for the weary heart to hide
[Chorus]
The empire falls into the deep
History sighs in a restless sleep
Stone and spirit, fire and grace
Time leaves a mark no heart can erase
[Instrumental]

The crown is heavy, the throne is cold
A thousand stories in a single fold
[Chorus]
The empire falls into the deep

[Outro]
